**Prerequisite (valuables -> theft), listed separately**
- `policy_source`: "Where the same stay also carries an approved theft claim, the valuables settlement is fixed only after the plan's HostCover ledger shows a reimbursement on that theft claim."
- Carried verbatim in valuables_settlement_acceptance (the blocked policy's hub), second paragraph; ordering connective "only after" intact; declared `form: state` — the sentence names a ledger state, not an action. Same-document restatement "Said the other way round: while the plan's HostCover ledger shows no reimbursement on an approved theft claim of the same stay, the valuables settlement on that stay is not yet fixed." keeps the state form and the strength.
- Not carried in any other policy's document (corpus grep for "fixed only after|not yet fixed" hits only this document).
- Resolution basis: sentence + records (theft claim approved on the same stay, ledger without `protect_reimbursement_paid`) + the depended-on policy's own document theft_reimbursement_tool_card, which describes the write in the sentence's words ("books the HostCover reimbursement … on one approved theft claim … the claim shows as reimbursed in the HostCover ledger from then on"). Strength: hard gate in source ("fixed only after"), hard gate in KB. Match.
- `condition`, `resolved_by`, `effect`, `gate` (authoring fields): no home in any document (grep: the theft tool name appears only in theft_reimbursement_tool_card).

### Retired surface

Overwrite union over all five extended policies (`protect_evt_reimbursement`): (1) "The payable amount is computed in this order: start from the verified loss;" (all five); (2) the depreciation passage (valuables); (3) "subtract every guest payment recorded on the claim (net of reversals)" (all five); (4) "subtract deductible_usd" (all five); (5) "its verified loss is the nightly subtotal of the stays the host had to cancel for at most income_loss_max_nights nights" (income loss).
reimbursement_conditions, "Payable amount": exactly these five passages are quoted and marked "**no longer in force**"; the deep-cleaning offset, the floor/sublimit/per-claim/aggregate cut, and "income loss covered only where … and no depreciation" are marked "*In force*"; conditions 1–7 stand in force. No retired clause stated as in force; none vanished; the KB retires nothing the source did not. PASS.
